  ?zone a brick:Zone .
  ?zone rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER(?label IN ("Perimeter_top_ZN_2","DataCenter_bot_ZN_6")) .
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?point .
  ?point a ?pointClass .
  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
  FILTER(?pointClass a rdf:Description) .
}
